title: CAMEO: A Co-design Architecture for Multi-objective Energy System Optimization
problem: Energy system co-design requires orchestrating heterogeneous components; monolithic solvers lack modularity
motivation: Complex interdependent optimization problems need flexible, scalable workflow framework
method: CAMEO: DAG-based modular workflow framework; JSON specs; containerized components; Nextflow orchestration
key_novelty: Plugin-and-play modular co-design framework; standardized component interfaces; diverse use cases
contributions: Demonstrated on power grid, battery, and distribution network problems
